events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,900.00 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May See Continued Consolidation
events.description: The China stock market has finished lower in two consecutive trading days, falling more than 80 points or 2.2 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,600-point plateau and it may extend those losses on Monday.

events.title: Malaysia Manufacturing PMI Climbs Into Expansion Territory - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Malaysia moved to expansion in October, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 51.0.

events.title: Japan Manufacturing PMI Slips To 53.3 In October - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Japan continued to expand in October, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 53.3.

events.title: Vietnam Manufacturing Sector Picks Up Steam In October - S&P Global

events.title: Australia Building Consents Climb 5.1% In September
events.description: The total number of building permits issued in Australia was up a seasonally adjusted 5.1 percent on month in September, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday - coming in at 17,948.

events.title: No Help Yet For Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, tumbling more than 1,800 points or 4 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 45,200-point plateau and it's expected to open in the red again on Monday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has moved lower in back-to-back sessions, slumping more than 20 points or 0.4 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,375-point plateau and it may extend its losses on Monday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Hand Back Friday's Gains
events.description: The Malaysia stock market bounced higher again on Friday, one day after ending the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 10 points or 0.6 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,615-point plateau although it may head south again on Monday.
